typeChartTool.title: Elemental Type Chart
typeChartTool.subtitle: Rows = attacking element · Columns = defending element. Click a header to highlight matchups.
typeChartTool.selectedAttack: Attacker selected: {element}. Click a defender to see the multiplier.
typeChartTool.selectedDefend: Defender selected: {element}. Click an attacker to see the multiplier.
typeChartTool.clickToSelect: Click any header element icon to select and highlight that row / column.
typeChartTool.rule2x: 2x (super effective): attacking element overcomes the defender, damage doubled.
typeChartTool.ruleHalf: ½x (not very effective): defender resists, damage halved.
typeChartTool.rule0: 0x (immune): defender is immune, no damage dealt.
typeChartTool.ruleSame: Attacks between the same element are usually halved (½x).

catchTool.title: Catch Condition Tool
catchTool.subtitle: Estimate base catch rates and get strategy tips based on Aniimo, Aniipod level, trap and time.
catchTool.placeholder: Fill in the conditions on the left, then click “Calculate Catch Rate”.
catchTool.calculationDetail: Catch rate = base value + Aniipod level bonus + trap bonus + break bonus + time bonus, capped between 1% and 98%. Values are placeholders until real game data is integrated.
catchTool.strategyBreak: Consider using BREAK first to greatly boost your catch rate
catchTool.strategyTrap: Consider switching to an advanced or master trap
catchTool.strategyRare: This Aniimo is rare; prepare advanced/master traps and strike while broken
catchTool.strategyDusk: Dusk gives the highest catch rate; consider waiting
catchTool.strategyIdeal: Your current setup is ideal — good luck catching!
